# StegVerse TV/TVC Authentication (Lite)
# Ephemeral secrets, platform-agnostic
# Version: 0.3.0-lite

name: stegverse-tvc-auth-lite
version: 0.3.0-lite

principles:
  - ephemeral_artifacts_only
  - no_hardcoded_secrets_in_files
  - no_long_lived_tokens
  - platform_agnostic_operations
  - ios_compatible_paths

workflow:
  1_request:
    action: tvc_request_token
    source: TrustVaultController

  2_validate:
    action: tvc_validate_token
    ephemeral: true
    lifetime: 300

  3_bind:
    action: bind_to_task
    scope: single_operation

  4_revoke:
    action: tvc_revoke_token
    trigger: on_completion | on_timeout | on_error

  5_audit:
    action: stegdb_write
    table: "{{org}}_tvc_audit_log"

file_constraints:
  no_hidden_files: true
  extension_policy: "use .txt for .yml configs in bundles"
